author: Carl Friedrich Gauss
quote: Mathematics is the queen of the sciences and number theory is the queen of mathematics.
reason: The citation belongs to a different entry. The line comes from Sartorius von Waltershausen, Gauss zum Gedachtniss (1856), p. 79 - a memorial written by a colleague after Gauss died, which is second-hand and would be rejected on that ground too. The row attached a "Letter to Bessel (1826)" locator that sits beside a different quote on the same Wikiquote page.
checked_against: https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Gauss/quotations/ and Moritz, Memorabilia Mathematica (1914), p. 271, both of which give Sartorius 1856 as the source
